component.name: TVMV
component.summary: Read and edit Markdown with a warm paper and ink theme

description.p: TVMV opens Markdown files in real windows and renders GitHub-Flavored Markdown with a warm reading theme built for long documents rather than for a code editor's sidebar.

The same rendering layer runs on macOS, iOS and Linux, over the same pinned cmark-gfm revision, so a document looks the same wherever it is opened. Everything is offline: no network access at any point.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting, KaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams
An outline sidebar, and find-in-page with a match count
A CodeMirror editor beside the preview, scrolling in step with it
Live reload when the file changes on disk, keeping your place
Print and Save-as-PDF through the desktop's own dialogs
Thumbnails in the file manager, and a chromeless quick preview
Body font, text size, line width and theme, plus your own stylesheet

description.p: First Linux release: GTK4 and WebKitGTK over the shared web layer.
